messages:
Emma Chen: Heads up — customer Acme (acct_id: acct_00421) flagged a month-end mismatch. Dashboard shows 1,234,567 tokens for Mar, invoice #INV-2026-03-004 shows 1,103,210 tokens and billed tier = Pro (should be Growth after 2026-03-20).
Raj Patel: digging. can you drop invoice id + billing snapshot time if you have it?
Emma Chen: INV-2026-03-004, billing snapshot time in invoice meta: 2026-04-01T00:10:12Z. dashboard pane for Acme shows last refreshed 2026-04-01T03:30:04Z. :thinking_face:
Mike Ortiz: that gap smells like a late aggregation/backfill. quick check — ran raw usage query that the dashboard uses:

```
SELECT customer_id, SUM(token_count) as tokens
FROM usage_events
WHERE customer_id='acct_00421'
  AND timestamp >= '2026-03-01' AND timestamp < '2026-04-01'
GROUP BY customer_id;
```

-> 1,234,567 tokens (matches dashboard)

Raj Patel: billing-run logs:
- billing-run v2 started 2026-04-01T00:05:12Z
- snapshot written 2026-04-01T00:10:12Z (commit 8f3d)
- invoice generation finished 2026-04-01T00:11:05Z

infra-bot: nocturnal-backfill job #823 finished 2026-04-01T03:14:50Z; affected partitions 2026-03-27..2026-03-31 (fixed missing events)

Lisa Gomez: so dashboard includes backfilled rows; invoice snapshot was taken before backfill finished — that explains lower token count.

Raj Patel: confirmed. billing snapshot query used `WHERE processed = true` + current aggregation table at 00:10Z. backfill set `processed=true` later. invoice didn't re-run. tier calc for that invoice used snapshot totals and historical plan mapping table as of snapshot time. looks like plan change on 2026-03-20 got applied to account after a downstream sync delay, but the plan_history table used for billing lookup was stale at 00:10Z -> billed as Pro.

Emma Chen: reproduction steps (what I did):
1) run billing snapshot query emulating 2026-04-01T00:10:12Z state: `SELECT SUM(tokens) FROM aggregates WHERE as_of <= '2026-04-01T00:10:12Z' AND customer_id='acct_00421'` -> 1,103,210
2) run same SELECT after applying backfilled partitions -> 1,234,567
3) compare plan_history as_of 00:10Z vs as_of 03:30Z, plan flip seen at 2026-03-20T14:22:18Z but replicated to billing_views at 2026-04-01T01:45:03Z

Mike Ortiz: quick notes on queries to share with eng-billing:
```
-- snapshot emulation
SELECT SUM(tokens) FROM aggregates_snapshot WHERE snapshot_ts='2026-04-01T00:10:12Z' AND customer_id='acct_00421';
-- after-backfill
SELECT SUM(tokens) FROM aggregates WHERE partition_date BETWEEN '2026-03-27' AND '2026-03-31' AND customer_id='acct_00421';
```

Raj Patel: next steps proposed:
- immediate: mark INV-2026-03-004 as pending adjustment and notify CS + Acme (Emma to draft)
- short term: re-run invoice generation for affected invoices after backfill and produce credit/adj if diffs > threshold
- medium: move billing snapshot to run after scheduled backfills OR make billing snapshot include eventual-consistent backfill flags
- long term: make plan change propagation to billing_views transactional or add plan change watermark check before invoice finalize

Lisa Gomez: agreed. acme already pinged and is nervous about tier downgrade. we should send a clear note explaining root cause and expected timeline (24-72h) for adj.

Emma Chen: i'll draft customer message now and tag legal for any wording constraints. also 👍 on automating snapshot-after-backfill check.

Raj Patel: assigning eng-billing, CCing eng-infra. ticket created: #BILL-5721

Mike Ortiz: FYI, small regression: backfill job changed partition prune behavior last deploy — created the late finish. will open infra PR to test partition ordering.

Emma Chen: thanks all. tagging this thread for followup in 48h. ✅
